description: A utility class for loading cryptographic keys and certificates from various sources such as key stores and PEM files. It provides methods to load private keys, public keys, and certificate chains, mainly for security setup within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: KeyLoader
classes.description: A final utility class that facilitates loading cryptographic keys and certificates from files or keystores, and provides access to the loaded key material.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the loaded private key, if any.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Returns the certificate chain associated with the loaded keys.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the public key extracted from the certificate chain.

methods.name: fromKeyStore
methods.description: Creates a KeyLoader instance from an existing keystore file, supporting JKS or PKCS12 formats.

methods.name: fromFiles
methods.description: Creates a KeyLoader instance from PEM files containing the private key and certificates.
